verdict.rationale: Polar ships SDKs, a CLI and a dashboard, so opting out of telemetry is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of telemetry or usage-tracking controls, or of any way to opt out. The usage-based billing event ingestion describes merchants metering their own customers' usage for billing, which is a different feature, and being open source is not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
